title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Nice to have


  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Tech Lead Backend NestJS
description:
Vaga: Arquiteto(a) Backend / Tech Lead Node.js


Sobre o Projeto:


A oportunidade é para atuar em um projeto estratégico de modernização de sistemas legados , com foco em reestruturação arquitetural, definição de padrões backend e implementação de práticas modernas orientadas a eventos em ambiente GCP .


Responsabilidades:

  • Definir e evoluir os padrões de arquitetura backend , garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenção dos sistemas.
  • Revisar código e realizar mentoria técnica com os desenvolvedores das equipes envolvidas no projeto.
  • Assegurar a aplicação de boas práticas de CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) e CDC (Change Data Capture) .
  • Apoiar a integração dos sistemas com o Integration Hub , promovendo comunicação eficiente entre serviços.
  • Ser referência técnica para múltiplas squads, conduzindo decisões de arquitetura e padronização de desenvolvimento.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de engenharia para promover uma cultura de qualidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Domínio em NestJS e Node.js .
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos .
  • Vivência sólida em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , incluindo Pub/Sub, Spanner e Firestore .
  • Experiência com projetos de modernização de sistemas legados .
  • Forte atuação em liderança técnica , com capacidade de orientar e elevar o nível técnico das equipes.


Desejável:

  • Experiência anterior como Tech Lead ou Arquiteto de Soluções Backend .
  • Atuação como referência técnica para múltiplas equipes em ambientes complexos.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD , testes automatizados e práticas de observabilidade.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Data Scientist who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving

Structure complex problems methodically

Modeling techniques, and experimental validation to deliver results

Communication Skills: capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

CI/CD pipelines

AWS

Big Data (Spark, cloud storage, Big Query, etc.)

Designs robust, scalable APIs, handles auth & versioning

Extracting insights from data to support business decisions.

Data wrangling

Statistical analysis

Design ML systems, evaluate trade-offs

Leads innovation with GenAI, custom model development

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Vaga: OPERADOR DE LOGÍSTICA


Local: Americana/SP


Muito mais do que apenas pisar no acelerador. Acreditamos que o movimento transforma e que a experiência de conduzir um veículo é também sobre confiar nos produtos que cuidam do seu carro enquanto você se concentra em seu caminho.


Somos Energy Petro, uma indústria de lubrificantes 100% brasileira sediada em Americana/SP.


Nosso propósito é proporcionar nossa gente a INSPIRAÇÃO, energia e os caminhos para que se tornem serem humanos melhores, em todas as esferas da vida.


Nossos valores são:


  • Família;
  • Coragem;
  • Resiliência;
  • Flexibilidade;


A marca Panther está presente em 24 estados do Brasil, com ampla e eficiente rede de distribuição dos nossos produtos.Contamos com mais de 150 produtos em nosso portfólio e grande capacidade de produção, nos mais altos padrões de qualidade, versatilidade e tecnologia.


Nosso diferencial, além da qualidade, está na nossa CULTURA DE FLEXIBILIDADE E PARCERIA com nossos clientes e colaboradores.


A Energy Petro está em expansão e buscamos Auxiliar de Logística para se juntar ao nosso time do segundo turno! Se você é apaixonado por marketing digital, tem habilidades analíticas e é movido por resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:


Dentre as suas principais responsabilidade, você irá encontrar:


  • Realizar a movimentação e armazenamento correto de cada produto ou insumo da empresa;
  • Manejo de equipamentos de acordo com sua estação de trabalho;
  • Realizar conferências, com objetivo de inventário, garantindo qualidade e registro adequado do produto;
  • Efetuar o carregamento e descarregamento de veículos;
  • Organização da área de trabalho;
  • Cuidado e zelo com os equipamentos de trabalho utilizados;
  • Utilização dos equipamentos adequados, garantindo a sua segurança e de colegas de trabalho.
  • Observação de todas as normas e uso dos equipamentos de segurança, garantindo a sua segurança e de colegas de trabalho.


Para essa posição, precisamos que você tenha as seguintes qualificações:


  • CNH Ativa;
  • Ensino médio completo ou técnico em Logística - Completo ou Cursando;
  • Conhecimento em Excel;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à logística e coordenação de transportadoras.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, capacidade de negociação e solução de problemas.
  • Formação NR - 35 (Trabalho em Altura);


A remuneração será compatível com o mercado, com a experiência e qualificação.


Nossos benefícios são:


  • Contratação CLT: 44 horas semanais com 1h de intervalo diário;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Flash;
  • Oportunidades de Desenvolvimento e Crescimento junto com a Energy;

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Data Scientist who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving

Structure complex problems methodically

Modeling techniques, and experimental validation to deliver results

Communication Skills: capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

CI/CD pipelines

AWS

Big Data (Spark, cloud storage, Big Query, etc.)

Designs robust, scalable APIs, handles auth & versioning

Extracting insights from data to support business decisions.

Data wrangling

Statistical analysis

Design ML systems, evaluate trade-offs

Leads innovation with GenAI, custom model development

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.

  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.

  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Consultor SAP MM/WM (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidade:

  • Consultor(a) para compor o time de AMS da NTT DATA realizando atendimento de chamados de sustentação e melhorias nos módulos MM/WM.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior Completo
  • Experiência como Consultor Pleno MM e WM.
  • Desejável conhecimento do EWM.
  • Experiência com implementação e/ou suporte AMS.
  • Inglês Avançado - Desejável


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Tipo de contrato: CLT


Garantimos que nossos funcionários sejam bem tratados, oferecendo pacotes de remuneração específicos para cada país, programas de reconhecimento e benefícios de prevenção. Dessa forma, incentivamos nossos colaboradores a terem o melhor desempenho e a comemorarem suas conquistas.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

Aqui na EQI estamos com vagas abertas para o Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores.

Se você está comprometido com sua evolução profissional e quer começar a trilhar um caminho de sucesso no mercado financeiro, inscreva-se agora !

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End | Hablla
description:
Sobre a Hablla

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas e de alta performance utilizando React.js e TypeScript , com foco em escalabilidade, responsividade e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de UX, backend, dados e produto, em um ambiente de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Participar da definição e manutenção do Design System e dos padrões de arquitetura front-end.
  • Implementar e manter o gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux com Redux-Saga .
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica do código, seguindo boas práticas de clean code e componentização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com React.js , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Tailwind e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Domínio de Redux e Redux-Saga .
  • Experiência com Vite ou Next.js .
  • Conhecimento de Git e GitHub para versionamento e colaboração.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Clean Architecture , Hooks , componentização e testes unitários .
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto, com foco em performance e experiência do usuário.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com integrações omnichannel (WhatsApp, Meta, e-mail e telefonia).
  • Experiência com Figma e colaboração com times de UX/UI.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas colaborativos em tempo real .
  • Interesse em IA aplicada à interface e personalização de jornada do usuário.
  • Ter trabalhado em ferramentas de CRM e/ou Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.
  • Cultura ágil, horizontal e orientada a resultados.
  • Contato direto com os founders e time de produto.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma startup em expansão internacional .

Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.
