title: Tech Lead Mobile (Flutter)
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de Tech Lead Flutter para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Sua missão será fundamental: liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento mobile, definindo padrões, boas práticas e a arquitetura do nosso aplicativo. Se você busca uma oportunidade para atuar com autonomia, impacto e influência técnica, esta é a sua chance de deixar sua marca desde o início!


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile nativos para iOS e Android, utilizando Flutter;
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis , baseadas em boas práticas como Clean Architecture, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Trabalhar na definição e implementação de Design Systems , garantindo interfaces modernas, acessíveis e consistentes;
  • Implementar e gerenciar o estado da aplicação (ex: BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, MobX);
  • Integrar com APIs RESTful , gerenciar estados (loading, error) e realizar persistência local (Hive, Isar, Drift ou SQLite);
  • Assegurar a qualidade e performance do código , conduzindo code reviews e promovendo boas práticas;
  • Colaborar com os times de Web, Backend, Produto e Design para garantir soluções integradas e de alto impacto;
  • Estabelecer e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD e automação de builds (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, etc.);
  • Realizar testes unitários, de integração e UI para garantir estabilidade e alta performance;
  • Ser referência técnica no time mobile, apoiando e orientando outros desenvolvedores.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência comprovada em Flutter/Dart.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de aplicativos mobile (iOS e Android) e dos processos de build e deploy (App Store e Google Play).
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de software , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de código.
  • Experiência em injeção de dependência (DI) e inversão de controle (IoC).
  • Integração com APIs RESTful e manipulação de dados (JSON).
  • Habilidade com testes unitários e de integração.
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git e fluxo Git Flow.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, comunicação clara e colaboração com stakeholders.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com testes de UI e automação.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (Sentry, Firebase Performance, Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e automação de builds.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Tech Lead Flutter e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na posição.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Responsabilidades

  • Participar da definição e manutenção do Design System e dos padrões de arquitetura front-end.

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Tech Lead Mobile (Flutter)
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de Tech Lead Flutter para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Sua missão será fundamental: liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento mobile, definindo padrões, boas práticas e a arquitetura do nosso aplicativo. Se você busca uma oportunidade para atuar com autonomia, impacto e influência técnica, esta é a sua chance de deixar sua marca desde o início!


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile nativos para iOS e Android, utilizando Flutter;
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis , baseadas em boas práticas como Clean Architecture, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Trabalhar na definição e implementação de Design Systems , garantindo interfaces modernas, acessíveis e consistentes;
  • Implementar e gerenciar o estado da aplicação (ex: BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, MobX);
  • Integrar com APIs RESTful , gerenciar estados (loading, error) e realizar persistência local (Hive, Isar, Drift ou SQLite);
  • Assegurar a qualidade e performance do código , conduzindo code reviews e promovendo boas práticas;
  • Colaborar com os times de Web, Backend, Produto e Design para garantir soluções integradas e de alto impacto;
  • Estabelecer e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD e automação de builds (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, etc.);
  • Realizar testes unitários, de integração e UI para garantir estabilidade e alta performance;
  • Ser referência técnica no time mobile, apoiando e orientando outros desenvolvedores.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência comprovada em Flutter/Dart.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de aplicativos mobile (iOS e Android) e dos processos de build e deploy (App Store e Google Play).
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de software , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de código.
  • Experiência em injeção de dependência (DI) e inversão de controle (IoC).
  • Integração com APIs RESTful e manipulação de dados (JSON).
  • Habilidade com testes unitários e de integração.
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git e fluxo Git Flow.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, comunicação clara e colaboração com stakeholders.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com testes de UI e automação.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (Sentry, Firebase Performance, Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e automação de builds.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Tech Lead Flutter e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na posição.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Tech Lead Mobile (Flutter)
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de Tech Lead Flutter para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Sua missão será fundamental: liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento mobile, definindo padrões, boas práticas e a arquitetura do nosso aplicativo. Se você busca uma oportunidade para atuar com autonomia, impacto e influência técnica, esta é a sua chance de deixar sua marca desde o início!


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile nativos para iOS e Android, utilizando Flutter;
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis , baseadas em boas práticas como Clean Architecture, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Trabalhar na definição e implementação de Design Systems , garantindo interfaces modernas, acessíveis e consistentes;
  • Implementar e gerenciar o estado da aplicação (ex: BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, MobX);
  • Integrar com APIs RESTful , gerenciar estados (loading, error) e realizar persistência local (Hive, Isar, Drift ou SQLite);
  • Assegurar a qualidade e performance do código , conduzindo code reviews e promovendo boas práticas;
  • Colaborar com os times de Web, Backend, Produto e Design para garantir soluções integradas e de alto impacto;
  • Estabelecer e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD e automação de builds (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, etc.);
  • Realizar testes unitários, de integração e UI para garantir estabilidade e alta performance;
  • Ser referência técnica no time mobile, apoiando e orientando outros desenvolvedores.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência comprovada em Flutter/Dart.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de aplicativos mobile (iOS e Android) e dos processos de build e deploy (App Store e Google Play).
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de software , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de código.
  • Experiência em injeção de dependência (DI) e inversão de controle (IoC).
  • Integração com APIs RESTful e manipulação de dados (JSON).
  • Habilidade com testes unitários e de integração.
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git e fluxo Git Flow.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, comunicação clara e colaboração com stakeholders.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com testes de UI e automação.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (Sentry, Firebase Performance, Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e automação de builds.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Tech Lead Flutter e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na posição.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End | Hablla
description:
Sobre a Hablla

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas e de alta performance utilizando React.js e TypeScript , com foco em escalabilidade, responsividade e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de UX, backend, dados e produto, em um ambiente de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Participar da definição e manutenção do Design System e dos padrões de arquitetura front-end.
  • Implementar e manter o gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux com Redux-Saga .
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica do código, seguindo boas práticas de clean code e componentização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com React.js , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Tailwind e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Domínio de Redux e Redux-Saga .
  • Experiência com Vite ou Next.js .
  • Conhecimento de Git e GitHub para versionamento e colaboração.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Clean Architecture , Hooks , componentização e testes unitários .
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto, com foco em performance e experiência do usuário.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com integrações omnichannel (WhatsApp, Meta, e-mail e telefonia).
  • Experiência com Figma e colaboração com times de UX/UI.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas colaborativos em tempo real .
  • Interesse em IA aplicada à interface e personalização de jornada do usuário.
  • Ter trabalhado em ferramentas de CRM e/ou Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.
  • Cultura ágil, horizontal e orientada a resultados.
  • Contato direto com os founders e time de produto.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma startup em expansão internacional .

title: AML Compliance Manager - AVP
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

The AML Compliance Manager AVP is responsible for leading the Anti-Money Laundering (AML/CTF) program, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory standards and group AML policies. This role oversees transaction monitoring, SAR/COAF reporting, KYx (KYC, KYB, KYS...) programs, training, and continuous strengthening of the AML control environment. Experience in designing AML controls for regulatory authorization is a strong advantage.


Responsibilities


1. AML Program Leadership

  • Manage and continuously enhance the AML/CTF Program in alignment with COAF , Bacen, and global standards.
  • Maintain AML policies, procedures, internal controls, and risk assessment frameworks (ML/TF Risk Assessment).
  • Conduct periodic reviews of the AML Program to ensure regulatory and market best-practice alignment.


2. Transaction Monitoring & Investigations

  • Oversee transaction monitoring rules, alerts, investigations, case documentation, and escalation process.
  • Lead internal investigations, suspicious activity reviews, and maintain clear audit trails for examination.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of SARs (Comunicados de Operações Suspeitas) to COAF .


3. Know Your Customer/Business (KYC/KYB) & Onboarding Controls

  • Lead KYC/KYB onboarding program , ensuring robust due diligence, ownership screening, risk scoring, sanctions check, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Partner with Investments, Credit, Risk, and Legal to ensure KYC/KYB controls are embedded in customer lifecycle management.
  • Oversee PEP, sanctions, and adverse media review frameworks.


4. Regulatory & Audit Management

  • Act as the point of contact for AML matters during regulatory exams, audits, and stakeholder reviews.
  • Prepare reporting for senior management, Committees, and Group AML stakeholders.
  • Support AML and compliance sections in Bacen licensing/authorization processes , including AML documentation and controls.



Skills, Experiences & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in law, Business, International Relations, or related field.
  • 7+ years of AML/FinCrime experience within financial institutions, PSPs, or fintechs.
  • Deep understanding of BCB Res. 3978/2020 , Bacen AML requirements, and international standards (FATF).
  • Experience in building AML frameworks for new regulatory authorization (e.g., Bacen licensing) is highly valued.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).

title: Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
description:
Who are we:

Neotalent Conclusion is one of the leading Iberian specialists providing services in Information Technology and Engineering services. As part of the Netherlands-based organization Conclusion, which has an ecosystem of over 25 companies and 3,600 employees, we are focused on increasing the technological capacity of our clients and the digital transformation of their application ecosystems.

We are talent specialists, attracting the best people and combining them with the needs of the most ambitious projects, at the right time. Our success comes from our investments in innovation, our focus on results, and, above all, the guarantee that our people will have happy and rewarding careers.

With over 25 years of solid experience, Neotalent Conclusion has established its presence in key locations, including Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid. The company currently has more than 950 professionals in the different areas in which it operates.

Neotalent, the responsive people.

Find out more about us at


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Dynamics 365 CE Solution Architect / CRM Consultant to join one of our biggest clients, a global technology consultancy focused on delivering high-impact digital solutions across industries.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead a strategic technical assessment, contribute to the simplification and optimisation of a complex CRM ecosystem, and help define the roadmap for long-term transformation, we have the ideal project for your career.

Come energize your future with us!


Location: Full-remote from Brazil (English fluency required)


What you will do:

• Evaluate the current Dynamics 365 CE architecture, customizations, entity model, and configuration

• Identify sources of complexity, performance bottlenecks, and fragility

• Recommend strategies to simplify the architecture and reduce technical debt

• Analyse integrations including Dataverse OData APIs, Outbound Event Messages, and ESB

• Review data flows, reconciliation challenges, and environment promotion processes

• Propose robust data governance and integration patterns

• Assess Azure DevOps pipelines and multi-environment deployment practices

• Recommend automation improvements for deployment reliability

• Review managed service framework and suggest future support models

• Produce findings and recommendations report

• Define short-term stabilisation and medium-term optimisation roadmap

• Prepare proposal for next-phase implementation


What you are like:

• Senior-level expertise in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Sales Enterprise module)

• Strong experience with integration technologies: Dataverse APIs, ESB messaging, web services

• Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment strategies

• Proven experience in CRM architecture rationalisation and modernisation

• Experience assessing managed service models and support optimisation

• Advanced problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

• Ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations

• Strong understanding of data modelling, reconciliation, and automation

• Comfortable working in fast-paced discovery phases (2–3 weeks)

• Proactive and independent, with strong alignment capabilities


Why join us:

• Work on challenging projects for big clients

• Learn more about emerging technologies

• Possibility of working remotely

• Design your career plan

• Access to continuous training and certifications

• Evolve through our internal mobility program

• … and much more!

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Foco Java


Requisitos para vaga:

  • Formação de nível superior na área de informática ou pós-graduação em TI com duração mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência desempenhando funções de desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando tecnologias JAVA e de 03 (três) anos como Desenvolvedor Sênior.
  • Possuir 1(uma) certificação dentre as listadas abaixo:

SUN Certified Java Programmer (SCJP) ou equivalente, emitido pela Sun Microsystems ou pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 8 Programmer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Java SE 17 Developer.

  • Experiência nas seguintes tecnologias e processos:
  • Angular e REST;
  • HTML 5 e CSS;
  • Hibernate;
  • Service-Oriented Architecture – SOA e desenvolvimento de web services;
  • Servidor de aplicações JBoss;
  • Openshift ou Kubernetes;
  • Maven/Jenkins (Geração/Automatização de builds);
  • Sonar (Validação de builds);
  • Controle de versões com GIT
  • Elastic
  • kafka
  • quarkus
  • Desejável Conhecimentos:
  • padrões de projeto (Design Patterns);
  • Openshift/Kubernetes;
  • DevOps/DevSecOps;
  • Test Driven Development – TDD e Behavior Driven Development – BDD.
  • Métricas de qualidade de código;
  • Técnicas para construção de software seguro;
  • Método Ágil Scrum.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Foco Java


Requisitos para vaga:

  • Formação de nível superior na área de informática ou pós-graduação em TI com duração mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência desempenhando funções de desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando tecnologias JAVA e de 03 (três) anos como Desenvolvedor Sênior.
  • Possuir 1(uma) certificação dentre as listadas abaixo:

SUN Certified Java Programmer (SCJP) ou equivalente, emitido pela Sun Microsystems ou pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 8 Programmer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer ou equivalente, emitido pela Oracle;

Oracle Java SE 17 Developer.

  • Experiência nas seguintes tecnologias e processos:
  • Angular e REST;
  • HTML 5 e CSS;
  • Hibernate;
  • Service-Oriented Architecture – SOA e desenvolvimento de web services;
  • Servidor de aplicações JBoss;
  • Openshift ou Kubernetes;
  • Maven/Jenkins (Geração/Automatização de builds);
  • Sonar (Validação de builds);
  • Controle de versões com GIT
  • Elastic
  • kafka
  • quarkus
  • Desejável Conhecimentos:
  • padrões de projeto (Design Patterns);
  • Openshift/Kubernetes;
  • DevOps/DevSecOps;
  • Test Driven Development – TDD e Behavior Driven Development – BDD.
  • Métricas de qualidade de código;
  • Técnicas para construção de software seguro;
  • Método Ágil Scrum.

title: Dentista clínico geral
description:
Descrição da Empresa Faça parte da equipe Cia do Sorriso

Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, éticos e com foco em resultados para atuar em uma clínica moderna, com fluxo de pacientes e estrutura completa.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Dentista Clínico Geral para se juntar à nossa equipe na. As responsabilidades desse cargo incluem realizar consultas e procedimentos clínicos odontológicos, diagnósticos, tratamentos preventivos e curativos, além de orientações para cuidados com a saúde bucal. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Consultas e Procedimentos Clínicos: É essencial realizar consultas, diagnósticos e tratamentos odontológicos diversos, clínico geral, endodontia e prótese.
  • Prevenção e Cuidados: Necessário possuir conhecimentos em tratamentos preventivos e medidas de cuidado contínuo para a saúde bucal dos pacientes.
  • Comunicação e Orientação: Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para orientar pacientes sobre higiene oral e cuidados pós-tratamento.

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.
